draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: Wrenfold outperforms Fennick-Base on the unseen test set of the Banking and Travel domains on which it was trained and tuned.
rationale: The evidence (T1.r1, T1.r2) shows Wrenfold beats Fennick-Base on the unseen test set of the same Banking and Travel domains used for training. No evaluation on any other (unseen) domain is reported, so the claim that the advantage "may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training" is unsupported speculation beyond the evaluated scope.
